    // Array3D is opaque too, so the layer stride is derived the same way: the
    // linear index of node (i, j, k) is (k * rows + j) * columns + i, the
    // row-major order the type's doc comment fixes.

    // The number of nodes along X.
    NodeColumns(self: SampledScalarGrid3D): Integer
        => self.Grid.CellCounts.X + 1;
